finite_export_algorithm: Resolve each explicitly approved original occurrence under its allowed exact run/root. Reject symlink or nonregular components, traversal, unknown paths, duplicate conflicting logical mappings, missing/stale originals and any file larger than100000000 bytes.

Record pre-copy regular-file identity/hash/bytes; read only named raw files with bounded descriptor-safe reader. Check raw length <=100000000 and same source identity/hash after read. Do not decode/normalize/reindent receipts, origins, logs or generated inputs for copying.

Create absent destination files only (no replace), preferably content-addressed sha256/<digest>.txt with exact byte identity. Deduplicate equal bytes after hash AND raw-byte equality, retaining one mapping row for EVERY distinct original occurrence. Leave all originals unchanged.

If exact bytes already have an immutable durable canonical evidence path, bind that retained path instead of making a second receipt blob. Preserve the original embedded .local absolute paths and attempt IDs in raw records.

Reread each original and copy, require identical SHA256+byte size and exact raw bytes. Recheck the finite allowlist and all recorded source identities after copying. Preserve any partial copy/failure evidence; do not silently fall through or delete old history.

Create one new immutable native-receipt-byte-custody-v1 manifest only after complete readback. Include finite allowlist identity and explicit exclusions/omissions; hash and reread the manifest. No update to original receipt status, origin ID or source pin.
future_destination: A NEW unique durable .noeaaeue/receipts/<chosen-export>/ tree; files stored as inert exact raw .txt objects, outside Lean source/import paths. No destination exists or is created by this plan.
hard_exclusions: No recursive .noeaaeue/.local archive or entire BASE export.

No .lake/packages/build/private build snapshots, .olean/.ilean/.c/.o or other binary object families; artifact hashes remain in original receipt/origin only. This source-only custody does not preserve reusable native cache artifacts.
No bulk .local/incremental-lean cache/artifact directories. Only explicit terminal origin/publication records and specifically required named source/census text evidence.
